title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
abstract: arXiv:2610.38331v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is now a common ingredient in language-model pre-training, as it improves downstream performance and enables faster inference through speculative decoding. We identify a flaw in standard MTP training, in which a residual component of the MTP gradient interferes with both next-token and multi-token learning, increasingly so with scale. Specifically, the MTP cross-entropy gradient can be decomposed exactly into a KL self-distillation term that pulls each MTP head toward the model's own next-token prediction (NTP) distribution and improves speculative decoding, and a residual that has a low signal-to-noise ratio and buries the useful KL signal. We introduce the KL gradient-recovery trick: when two distributions share a linear output head, the gradient of their KL divergence can be recovered exactly by combining their cross-entropy gradients through straight-through gradient routing. translated_title: 多词元预测的正确做法
translated_abstract: 多词元预测现已成为语言模型预训练中的常见组成部分，因为它能够提升下游性能，并通过投机解码实现更快的推理。我们发现了标准 MTP 训练中的一个缺陷：MTP 梯度中的一个残差分量会同时干扰下一词元预测和多词元预测的学习，且模型规模越大，这种干扰越严重。具体而言，MTP 的交叉熵梯度可以被精确分解为两部分：一个 KL 自蒸馏项，它将每个 MTP 头拉向模型自身的下一词元预测（NTP）分布，并能改善投机解码；以及一个信噪比低、会掩盖有用 KL 信号的残差项。我们提出了 KL 梯度恢复技巧：当两个分布共享一个线性输出头时，可以通过直通梯度路由组合二者的交叉熵梯度，从而精确恢复它们之间 KL 散度的梯度。与直接最小化 KL 散度不同（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文揭示了标准多词元预测（MTP）训练中低信噪比的残差梯度会干扰模型学习，并提出 KL 梯度恢复技巧，通过直通梯度路由从交叉熵梯度中精确恢复 KL 自蒸馏梯度，从而提升语言模型性能与投机解码效果。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a flaw in standard Multi-Token Prediction training where a low signal-to-noise residual gradient interferes with learning, and introduces a KL gradient-recovery trick that exactly recovers the KL self-distillation gradient by combining cross-entropy gradients via straight-through gradient routing, improving both model performance and speculative decoding.
